method: Exact byte relocation against user supplied Rev 2 followed by manual 65C816 decoding; USA 1.0 source used only for navigation and state names.
units: Speed raw is signed 8.8 SNES pixels per simulation tick, consistent with verified position integration; raw / 256 gives pixels/tick. World scale and seconds conversion are adaptation choices.

buddyRunTargets.manual65C816Decoding: Load rider buddy slot $0512,Y; compare buddy sprite $0D45,X with Expresso $000A and Winky $000B; return $0380 by default, $0300 for Winky, $0400 for Expresso.
buddyRunTargets.limitation: Local target speed, before character/state modifiers; not a universal observed maximum.

buddyWalkTargets.manual65C816Decoding: Same buddy dispatch; return $0200 by default and for Winky, $0300 for Expresso.
buddyWalkTargets.limitation: The default branch includes other mounted types; source names alone do not establish all callers.

rollBaseSpeeds.manual65C816Decoding: LDA #$0100; STA $16F1,Y; LDA $7E; AND #$0300; BEQ +6; LDA #$0300; STA $16F1,Y.
rollBaseSpeeds.limitation: Roll/cartwheel speed accumulator initialization; additional bonus and character scaling follow.

recentRunRollBonus.manual65C816Decoding: Store current counter $28; subtract timestamp $16E1,Y; if result below $0010, set roll speed $0400 and flag $0040.
recentRunRollBonus.limitation: Timestamp role is inferred from adjacent source updating it during running; signed comparison and clock wrap require runtime testing.

cartwheelSpeedScaling.manual65C816Decoding: Compare current sprite index $82 with $0002; other index adds accumulator>>3 to itself.
cartwheelSpeedScaling.limitation: For nonnegative raw speed, multiplier is 1.125 with integer truncation; index-to-character labeling comes from navigation source.

rollChainAcceleration.manual65C816Decoding: LDA $16F1,Y; CLC; ADC #$0100; CMP #$0800; BMI +3; LDA #$0800; STA $16F1,Y.
rollChainAcceleration.limitation: The local routine is reached from roll chaining states; exact enemy-hit timing and duration are not traced.

rollingJumpGroundBypass.manual65C816Decoding: States $0012/$0013/$0019 branch past ordinary ground/terrain checks to shared jump setup.
rollingJumpGroundBypass.limitation: Supports roll/cartwheel off-edge jump eligibility while roll state persists; it does not establish an arbitrary grace timer.

expressoFlutterEntry.manual65C816Decoding: Set vertical speed $0400; add $0018 to Y position; request animation $0043 through $BE8092.
expressoFlutterEntry.limitation: Entry behavior only. This is not a fall-speed cap; the animation/physics continuation must be traced separately.

riderAirGravity.manual65C816Decoding: Set rider state $0015; store $FFB8 to $16F9,Y; request mounted jump animation $002E.
riderAirGravity.limitation: Mounted land jump setup; the separate animation impulse signatures below establish initial velocity but not total jump height.

enguardeStabEntry.manual65C816Decoding: Check current animation $003D; request mounted-family attack $003A via dispatcher; zero vertical speed; enter state $004C.
enguardeStabEntry.limitation: Mounted animation dispatch maps attack family to Enguarde. Separate animation signature below verifies impulse, not full duration.

rambiExpressoJumpImpulse.manual65C816Decoding: LDA #$0700; STA $0EF1,X; request animal jump sound $005F; RTL. Two adjacent instances are called from mounted Rambi and Expresso animation scripts.
rambiExpressoJumpImpulse.limitation: The impulse occurs after animation preparation, not necessarily on the input tick. Calls at 0x3EC139/0x3EC1B1 target $BEA7EF (Rambi); 0x3EC9E5/0x3ECACF target $BEA7FD (Expresso).

winkyJumpImpulse.manual65C816Decoding: LDA #$0800; STA $0EF1,X; request animal jump sound $005F; RTL.
winkyJumpImpulse.limitation: Called by Winky mounted animation after preparation poses; calls 0x3EC570/0x3EC698 target $BEA80B. Full jump height still depends on held input, gravity and contact.

enguardeStabImpulse.manual65C816Decoding: Set state $004D; choose signed $0400 according to horizontal flip flag; store current and target horizontal speed; play Enguarde stab sound.
enguardeStabImpulse.limitation: Animation call at 0x3EBBC4 targets $BEBC17. Attack duration and all interruption/collision paths still need runtime verification.

airGravitySelector.manual65C816Decoding: If $1699,Y bit $0002 is set, use acceleration parameter $16F9,Y; otherwise use $FF90. Add to vertical velocity with negative cap $F800.
airGravitySelector.limitation: Combined with mounted jump setup this establishes -72 while that flag persists. Exact input release/state lifetime still requires execution traces.

limitations: No SNES execution, complete decompilation, cycle-accurate timing or frame-perfect parity claim.
Exact mounted jump heights/timing, Expresso sustained flutter, Enguarde dash duration, mounted damage/recovery and every original level are not completely traced.
Some semantics use labeled USA 1.0 navigation source; verified bytes establish only the decoded local operations and branch conditions.
